summary: Read-only end-to-end audit completed on public preview URL with desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844). Login/session flow works, required routes are reachable, Model Approval shows Recovery checks with M8-T1/M9-T3 and AnswerQuality shows 'Run 200-question check'. No forbidden mutation actions were triggered.

minor.issue: Returns empty rows in this environment (no recorded answer-quality runs). UI correctly shows run CTA; no run was started due read-only scope.

ui_bugs.issue: Milestone prose requested by audit is not visibly present in current Model Approval surface text; owner-ruling prose is present via deferred recovery lines.

Mounted routes in App.js map /os/work/tasks and watch family paths to AdminEstate shell, so expected Honest-gap/PHASE/R-ID/source-file placeholder evidence is not directly visible on those mounted paths.

action_items: If milestone prose is a hard product requirement for Model Approval, add explicit milestone-owner narrative text in the visible surface (not only backend records).
Reconfirm whether mounted route targets for /os/work/tasks and watch routes should stay on AdminEstate shell or point to dedicated My Work/Watch placeholder surfaces for audit evidence parity.
critical_code_review_comments: Registry is wired through useRegistryExperience (OwnerOSPage.jsx line 56); no dead CensusWorkspace hook is used for registry rendering.
App.js mounted routes currently use AdminEstate for /os/work/tasks and watchSections, which affects expected placeholder evidence discoverability on those direct paths.
Model Approval uses live reads from /api/training/m9/* and /api/continuity/*; AnswerQuality CTA label is correctly exposed as 'Run 200-question check'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route matrix checked (desktop + mobile): /os/work/chat, /os/work/documents, /os/work/media, /os/admin/estate, /os/build/train, /os/work/tasks, /os/admin/greymirror/watch/state, /os/admin/rulesupd, /dap/entitlement, /os/admin/modeladmission. Confirmed sessionStorage key akki_access_token set after login. Confirmed Model Approval details expose M8-T1 and M9-T3 in Recovery checks and AnswerQuality button text 'Run 200-question check'. Forbidden actions not clicked: benchmark/run census/health checks/GPU-training/chat send/build mutations.
rca of the issue: Requirement gap is mainly evidence-surface alignment: (1) milestone prose not directly visible in Model Approval despite owner-ruling and drill evidence being present; (2) mounted route targets for My Work/Watch point to AdminEstate shell, which suppresses direct Honest-gap/PHASE/R-ID/source-file placeholder text expected by audit phrasing.
